verdict.rationale: Greptile ships an official CLI (`greptile review`, `greptile onboard`) that reviews local/feature-branch diffs and returns a 0-5 safety score, and docs note coding agents can invoke the CLI to review their own code, implying scriptable/automatable use. However, there is no explicit documentation of a machine-readable output format (e.g., JSON flag) or dedicated CI pipeline integration examples — only an OpenAPI/CLI probe confirming the CLI page exists with no schema found. Missing for 10: documented JSON/structured output mode, explicit CI script examples, and independent confirmation of CLI reliability in automation contexts.
